hotels.title: Kings Canyon Outback Retreat with Daily Breakfast & Bruce Munro's Light-Towers Experience
hotels.description: Experience a one-of-a-kind escape to a true outback oasis just a stone’s throw from the ancient geological wonders of Watarrka National Park and George Gill Range. Explore the renowned Light-Towers installation, an enchanting maze of sound and light by acclaimed artist Bruce Munro, then soothe your muscles in the refreshing, lagoon-style swimming pool. Adventurous travellers looking to explore the heart of Australia’s Red Centre can experience unparalleled seclusion - the resort is an easy 3.5-hour drive from Uluṟu - while still being within easy reach of some of the country’s best outback sights. Enjoy day trips to the awe-inspiring neighbouring National Park and wonder at 360 degree views during the spellbinding Kings Canyon Rim Walk, made famous by the iconic Australian movie Priscilla Queen of the Desert. Relax in the comfort of your unique accommodation, savour dishes crafted from native ingredients at Carmichael’s Restaurant and clink your glasses to your memorable stay at the rustic Kings Canyon Bar & Grill.
